title: East of Eden
author: John Steinbeck
engineRationale: East of Eden is a character- and scene-driven Salinas Valley family saga with specific, distinct dramatis personae (Cathy/Kate, Adam & Cal Trask, Aron, Samuel Hamilton, Lee) and vivid dramatic tableaux — photoreal Flux cut-outs of nameable period figures fit far better than an abstract everyman vector rig.
